# /crav1-whats-known-about

[All skills](../skills.md) · Walkthrough: [What's known about one thing](../../from-whats-known-about.md) · Playbook: [`SKILL.md`](../../../.cursor/skills/crav1/crav1-whats-known-about/SKILL.md)

## Purpose

Answer one question about a feature, slice, resource, or not-yet-feature from the specs first.

## Runs when

One feature, slice, or resource. Called by the user.

## Reads

In short: The matching spec, system notes, then live checks.

Reads one name, a sentence or two, an `@` path, or a focus, then the matching spec, plan, tasks, Match, open questions, and Research findings, plus `docs/system/`, `docs/architecture/spec.md`, and `docs/environments/marks.md`. Shows a stale research note as stale. After that, reads Azure resource settings and recent changes, and Azure DevOps work items, open pull requests, and branches. When the git remote is not Azure Repos and `docs/environments/marks.md` does not name the Azure DevOps org and project, derives them from Azure DevOps URLs in `docs/system/repos.md` and reads those work items, pull requests, and branches the same way, each tagged as a live read. Before reporting `az` as not installed, checks the default install paths on Windows, macOS, and Linux and uses that path when it is there.

## Writes

In short: Nothing.

Writes nothing.

## Does not

Leaves specs, code, marks, commits, and pull requests alone.

Limits and exceptions: pasted minutes or a long dump stops and names [`/crav1-meeting-to-specs`](crav1-meeting-to-specs.md) or [`/crav1-match-dump-to-specs`](crav1-match-dump-to-specs.md). Two or more close hits ask which. A live-read failure offers Retry or Skip. It does not start Specify, Plan, or Build. It is not a starter option.

- Runs by itself: Calls no skill.
